Welcome — glad to start the vendor setup for Clarion Health. I'm Laura from Procurement; looping in Rishi (account lead) and Dev (payments) so we can align on legal/privacy and PO/billing details.

Attached is our standard onboarding checklist and a PO template to speed things up. For the initial procurement packet could you please confirm the following by EOD tomorrow if possible:

- Do you have an executed DPA or will Clarion sign our DPA? If you already have a standard DPA, please attach.

- Data retention policies by data type (logs, backups, user content).

Marc — appreciate the quick responses. A few follow-ups and a concise checklist to help procurement/legal/security close this without back-and-forth: please reply inline or attach documents where noted.

Procurement/Billing (Dev):
- Confirm legal entity for the contract and the exact remittance mailing address for the invoice.
- Who is the authorized signer (name, title) for contracts?
- Confirm W-9 or equivalent tax form.
- Do you require a purchase order for first invoice? If so, sample PO format/number.

Data privacy & security (Legal/Security):
1) DPA: Will you sign Redwood's DPA as-is? If you propose redlines, provide a tracked PDF.
2) Subprocessors: please provide the latest spreadsheet (name, country, role, data accessed). If any subprocessor handles PHI, flag it.
3) Data retention: Provide retention by category: a) application logs, b) user content, c) backups, d) analytics/metrics. Preferred retention window and deletion workflow.
4) Data residency: Any restrictions on where Clarion customer data must be stored/processed? (US-only, EU, etc.)
5) Encryption: At-rest and in-transit encryption in use? KMS/HSM details if applicable.
6) Incident response: Contact and SLA for security incidents; notify timelines and test cadence.
7) Access control: Roles with production access, MFA enforcement, background checks for admins.
8) Backups & restore: RPO/RTO targets and retention policy.
9) PHI/PCI scope: Is PHI expected to be sent to Redwood? If yes, do you require a BAA?
10) Attestations: SOC2/ISO certs — if full report is restricted, provide summary and POA for access process.

Operational notes:
- Preferred start for billing (invoice effective date) so we can align PO and contract.
- Any blackout windows or maintenance windows we should be aware of.

I've placed a short procurement/privacy quicklist in Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=redwood_procurement_template_2025 (see section "Clarion intake"). Attaching a small checklist as well.

If you can get the DPA redline and updated subprocessors back by EOD tomorrow, Procurement and Legal can draft the PO and route for signature next week.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Procurement_Privacy_Quicklist.xlsx (6KB stub)

Rishi/Laura/Dev — thanks for the checklist, below are our consolidated responses and next steps. I've attached updated docs.

Procurement/Billing:
- Legal entity: Clarion Health, Inc.
- Remit: 220 Hanover St, Boston, MA 02108
- Authorized signer: Mark James, CFO (mark.james@clarion-health.com)
- W-9 attached (will send via secure link if needed).
- We accept POs; first invoice will reference PO # if provided. Net30 standard.

Privacy & Security (answers):
1) DPA: We will sign Redwood's DPA. Attached is our signed redline; items are mostly language clarifications. Expected to finalize within 48 hours.
2) Subprocessors: Attached updated list (Clarion_Subprocessors_v2.xlsx) with columns for data access scope and whether PHI is handled. Two subprocessors flagged for PHI (vendor IDs 101, 119).
3) Retention: a) App logs: 90 days; b) User content: retained per customer agreement (default 1 year); c) Backups: 1 year; d) Analytics: 3 years. Deletion: documented workflow with soft-delete + purge after retention window.
4) Data residency: No EU-only restriction for this engagement; can discuss if a specific customer requires it.
5) Encryption: TLS1.3 in transit; AES-256 at rest. KMS: AWS KMS customer-managed keys available on request.
6) Incident response: Security contact Marina Lopez (marina.lopez@clarion-health.com). They commit to 24-hour initial triage and follow Redwood SLA for notification.
7) Access control: RBAC in place, MFA required for all admins, quarterly access reviews.
8) Backups & restore: RPO 4 hours, RTO 8 hours for core services.
9) PHI/PCI: PHI may be processed per customer agreement. Clarion can execute a BAA if required; will coordinate with legal.
10) Attestations: SOC2 Type II summary attached; full report available under NDA.

Next steps: attaching Clarion_DPA_Signed_Draft.pdf and Clarion_Security_Attestation.pdf. We will countersign Redwood's DPA and confirm bank details for the first invoice by COB Monday.

Let me know if you want a quick 20-min sync early next week to finish PO & DPA.

Best,
Marc
